body:
## Stardate today. Quiet orbit.

Woke on schedule. Ran the morning checklist without skipping a step, which the crew (me) noted with approval. **Completed the hydration objective before coffee**, a first.

- Objective: ten pages read. Done, on the shuttle in.
- Objective: lights out by eleven. Holding.
- Comms: called home. Signal strong.

> Manoeuvre I'm proud of: launched the walk when the weather said abort. Orbit stable, Captain.
